candidates.name: wmma_planar_iso

reject_reasons: experimental opt-in path; needs standalone coherence/perf smokes before promotion

candidates.name: tile_or_full_temp_quantized
candidates.notes: Useful for non-quant/f16 cases, not the 24 GB long-context compressed-KV target.
reject_reasons: can materialize full f16 K/V temp buffers and erase compressed-KV memory savings
